notes.omweso: A traditional board game played with seeds.

guidebook.intro: Football is a passion across Uganda, music is everywhere, and there’s always a game of omweso under a tree somewhere.

tips.title: Saying what you like doing
body: Put a **ku-** infinitive after **Nyumirwa** (I enjoy) or **Njagala** (I like, I want): **Nyumirwa okuwuga**.
Join two activities with **n’** (and) before a vowel: **okuyimba n’okuzina**. Join two sentences with **era**: **Nsoma, era nzanya**.

culture.title: The Cranes
body: Uganda’s national football team is called the Cranes, after the crested crane. On big match nights, crowds gather around any TV to watch, and a goal brings shouts of **Goolo!** from every house.

culture.title: Omweso
body: **Omweso** is a fast board game of four rows of pits and 64 seeds, related to games played all over Africa. Skilled players count and move seeds faster than you can follow.
